name: magnified-doc

frames.best_why: The search icon is clearly enlarged and its small labelled tooltip sits above it, showing both behaviours at once.

tagline: Hovering an icon swells it and lifts a small bordered label above.
summary: A tooltip wrapper for icon controls: pointing at or focusing a trigger opens a compact dark label with a hairline border and blurred backing, while the demo dock grows the icon under the cursor.
appearance: A long rounded dark bar holds seven thin line icons spaced evenly across it. Above whichever icon is active, a small rounded dark label with a faint border and light text floats a short gap away.
behaviour: The pointed-at icon enlarges while its neighbours stay small, and a label fades and zooms in directly above it. Moving off shrinks the icon back and the label fades away; the label also opens on keyboard focus.
demo_content: Seven icons named Home, Search, Files, Mail, Calendar, Music and Settings, plus a Hover the dock hint.
search_phrases: label that appears above an icon
dark tooltip with blur behind it
mac style dock that grows icons
floating name for a toolbar icon
hover hint for icon only buttons
use_when: Icon-only controls need a short name on hover or focus without taking up layout space.
avoid_when: Adopting it gives you only the label; the growing dock and springs belong to the demo, not the exported parts.
customise: Wrap your own trigger and label in the compound parts; className passes to the label, and side, sideOffset and the provider delay control placement and timing.
weight_why: A few buttons and springs that only move while the pointer is over the bar.

a11y.note: Each icon has an aria-label and the tooltip opens on focus, but the buttons remove the focus outline with no replacement.

issues: The growing dock is demo code; the component exports only the tooltip parts.
Icon buttons set focus:outline-none, so keyboard focus has no visible ring.
The label overlaps the Hover the dock hint when a middle icon is pointed at.
polish_why: Crisp icons and tidy label styling; the label collides with the hint text.
title: Magnified Doc Tooltip
